|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[The Dark Path (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[The Dark Path (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Errata (September 2007)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The surviving remastered sheet specifically dates this replacement to 14 September 2007. It replaces the explicit once-per-battle redraw wording with a during-battle just-drew condition and expressly cancels that destiny. It also retimes the optional Force loss to when battle destiny is drawn. The change in literal frequency wording does not independently establish unlimited redraws. [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=1 Publisher cover dates the replacement]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20071207062637id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v5/ds/thedarkpath.gif Publisher gallery corroboration]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 Period One Rule].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf Virtual Set #5 first release sheet] (theforce.net, 30 May 2003; Internet Archive 1 August 2003), page 3, slip 49.
* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf Virtual Set #5 revised sheet] (publisher index dates the edition 19 June 2003), res.starwarsccg.org, page 3, slip 49.
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf VirtualCards5.pdf] (Remaster sheet, official text as of 4 December 2006; Internet Archive 24 October 2007).
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[The Dark Path]].

=== Publication sources ===
* '''Source publication''' (this page): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 3, slip 49 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “Deploy on table. Once per battle, may lose your just drawn destiny to cause a redraw. After drawing battle destiny, may lose X Force (limit 3) to add X attrition against opponent.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•49” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS5-49-The_Dark_Path-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]]).
* '''Source publication''' ([[The Dark Path (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 49), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table. During battle, if you just drew a destiny, may lose that card to cancel and redraw that destiny. When you draw battle destiny, may lose X Force (limit 3) to make attrition against opponent +X.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card. The Committee's errata sheet “Errata: September 17, 2007” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20071026144228/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/Errata9_17.pdf Errata9_17.pdf], Internet Archive capture 26 October 2007) reprints this slip unchanged ([[:File:OVS5-49-The_Dark_Path-errata-sheet-2007-09-17.png]]), so it is an extra image of this version, not a new one. The December 2006 wording before that errata is not preserved: every surviving copy of the Remaster sheet already carries it.
|hatnote=This is the original 30 May 2003 printing of [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]] (old pre-Remaster slip). For the current text, see [[The Dark Path (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[The Dark Path]].
|effective=6 June 2003<ref name="date-ovs5-release-20030530" />
